supersedes.qualification: The earlier historical-package-mutation finding accurately described the old direct verifier invocation. This receipt reviews the new isolated wrapper and the updated workflow invocation.

result.former_blocker: Closed for the updated workflow path: the unchanged historical verifier now runs only on copied fixed-RTE and historical-RTE packages in a TemporaryDirectory. The analyzer's write to two_by_two_analysis.json is confined to that disposable copy.
checks: The wrapper calculates size and SHA-256 pins for every regular package file and the harness before copying; it rejects symlinks.
It verifies that the disposable copies match the originals before execution, and rechecks both disposable and original trees after the child exits.
The wrapper starts the historical verifier in a new process group, enforces a 120-second wait, and sends SIGKILL to the process group on any BaseException/timeout before reaping the direct child.
The historical workflow still runs the fixed-RTE package verifier first, then the isolated historical wrapper; its trigger includes the wrapper and both package trees.
The workflow retains read-only contents permission, pinned checkout action, and five-minute job timeout.
nonblocking_hardening: The positive-Nc-activation and fractional-CF workflows still use actions/checkout@v4 instead of an immutable checkout commit.
result.scope: Static source review only. No wrapper/verifier was run. The wrapper does not add model, compiler, or radiation-solver calls. Scientific scope and unresolved physical/strict-gate limitations remain as documented in the package README files.
